agyos_skill.intent: Use when managing freelance project crises, scope creep requests, difficult client relationships, payment disputes, freelancer burnout, or shifting business/market niches.
agyos_skill.instructions: Protect your time, sanity, and income when projects go sideways. This module is your insurance policy — use it before small problems become career-damaging crises. To utilize this skill's scripts, crisis workflows, or templates, read the corresponding document in the `references/` directory: | File | Focus | Purpose | |------|-------|---------| | [08A-SCOPE-CREEP-DEFENSE.md](references/08A-SCOPE-CREEP-DEFENSE.md) | Scope Creep Defense | Change requests, pricing add-ons, SOW amendments, script replies when client asks for "just one more thing" | | [08B-DIFFICULT-CLIENTS.md](references/08B-DIFFICULT-CLIENTS.md) | Difficult Clients | Conflict resolution scripts, how to fire clients, late payment escalation sequence, collection agency/legal notice templates | | [08C-BURNOUT-PREVENTION.md](references/08C-BURNOUT-PREVENTION.md) | Burnout Prevention | boundary setting, task delegation, emergency 48-hour recovery protocols, financial buffer planning | | [08D-PIVOT-STRATEGIES.md](references/08D-PIVOT-STRATEGIES.md) | Pivot Strategies | Niche shift checklist, rate increase calculation model, new market research templates | When a client requests feature modifications or additions not listed in the initial SOW: - Reference [08A-SCOPE-CREEP-DEFENSE.md](references/08A-SCOPE-CREEP-DEFENSE.md) to draft a Change Request response. - Present two options: either increase the budget to accommodate the new request, or defer the request to a post-launch Phase 2 project. - Implement revision logs to track how many changes the client has used. When a client delays invoice payments or becomes hostile: - Reference [08B-DIFFICULT-CLIENTS.md](references/08B-DIFFICULT-CLIENTS.md) to initiate the **Late Payment Escalation Sequence** (Polite Reminder $\rightarrow$ Firm Notice $\rightarrow$ Access Suspension $\rightarrow$ Legal Demand $\rightarrow$ Collections). - Use conflict-resolution templates to de-escalate emotional disputes while maintaining contract rights. - If needed, follow the professional guide on how to terminate a client relationship without legal exposure. When the freelancer reports extreme stress, exhaustion, or long hours: - Reference [08C-BURNOUT-PREVENTION.md](references/08C-BURNOUT-PREVENTION.md) to audit their workload and activate the **48-Hour Recovery Protocol**. - Set up system boundaries (disable Slack/email on weekends, configure auto-responders) and plan a 6-month financial runway to reduce operational anxiety. When client acquisition plateaus or current skills drop in demand: - Reference [08D-PIVOT-STRATEGIES.md](references/08D-PIVOT-STRATEGIES.md) to run a niche audit. - Map adjacent skills (e.g., shifting from plain ML modeling to ML Security Audits or LLM Evaluation) to raise rates by 30-45%. | Concept | File | Section | One-Line Summary | |---------|------|---------|------------------| | Change Request Template | [08A](references/08A-SCOPE-CREEP-DEFENSE.md) | 2 | "I'd love to help with [X]. Here is the estimated budget, or we can queue it for Phase 2." |
